mapper.select: SELECT * FROM quant_strategy_position_rebuild_run WHERE id=#{runId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quant_strategy_position_rebuild_inventory (run_id,credential_id,symbol,strategy_instance_id,position_side,strategy_id,open_quantity,cost_basis, realized_pnl,preserved_realized_pnl,cycle_number,preserved_cycle_number,cycle_id,last_trade_time,last_trade_id, preserved_last_trade_time,preserved_last_trade_id) SELECT #{runId},i.credential_id,i.symbol,i.strategy_instance_id,i.position_side,i.strategy_id,0,0, i.realized_pnl,i.realized_pnl,cycle_floor.cycle_number,cycle_floor.cycle_number, NULL,NULL,NULL,i.last_trade_time,i.last_trade_id FROM quant_strategy_position_inventory i JOIN quant_strategy_position_rebuild_run r ON r.id=#{runId} CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COALESCE(MAX(c.cycle_number),0) AS cycle_number FROM quant_strategy_position_cycle c WHERE c.credential_id=i.credential_id AND c.symbol=i.symbol AND c.strategy_instance_id=i.strategy_instance_id AND c.position_side=i.position_side AND c.opened_at<r.history_from ) cycle_floor WHERE i.credential_id=#{credentialId} AND i.symbol=#{symbol}
mapper.select: SELECT strategy_id,open_quantity,cost_basis,cycle_number,cycle_id,last_trade_time,last_trade_id FROM quant_strategy_position_rebuild_inventory WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND strategy_instance_id=#{instanceId} AND position_side=#{side} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quant_strategy_position_rebuild_fill WHERE run_id=#{runId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(open_quantity),0) FROM quant_strategy_position_rebuild_inventory WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND position_side=#{side}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quant_strategy_position_rebuild_inventory i LEFT JOIN quant_strategy_position_cycle c ON c.id=i.cycle_id WHERE i.run_id=#{runId} AND i.open_quantity>0 AND (i.cycle_id IS NULL OR i.cost_basis<=0 OR c.id IS NULL OR c.closed_at IS NOT NULL OR c.credential_id<>i.credential_id OR c.symbol<>i.symbol OR c.strategy_instance_id<>i.strategy_instance_id OR c.position_side<>i.position_side)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quant_strategy_fill_journal WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND symbol=#{symbol} AND id>#{maxId}
mapper.update: UPDATE quant_strategy_position_rebuild_run SET processed_count=processed_count+#{processed},cursor_trade_time=#{cursorTradeTime}, cursor_trade_id=#{cursorTradeId},updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{runId} AND status='BUILDING'
UPDATE quant_strategy_position_rebuild_run SET status='READY',updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{runId} AND status='BUILDING'
UPDATE quant_strategy_position_rebuild_run SET status='FAILED',failure_reason=#{reason},active_run_key=NULL,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{runId} AND status IN ('BUILDING','READY')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quant_strategy_position_inventory (credential_id,symbol,strategy_instance_id,position_side,strategy_id,open_quantity,cost_basis,realized_pnl, commissions,commission_asset,cycle_number,cycle_id,last_trade_time,last_trade_id,updated_at) SELECT credential_id,symbol,strategy_instance_id,position_side,strategy_id,open_quantity,cost_basis, preserved_realized_pnl,0,NULL,GREATEST(cycle_number,preserved_cycle_number),cycle_id, COALESCE(last_trade_time,preserved_last_trade_time), COALESCE(last_trade_id,preserved_last_trade_id),NOW(6) FROM quant_strategy_position_rebuild_inventory WHERE run_id=#{runId} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE strategy_id=VALUES(strategy_id),open_quantity=VALUES(open_quantity),cost_basis=VALUES(cost_basis), realized_pnl=VALUES(realized_pnl),commissions=0,commission_asset=NULL, cycle_number=VALUES(cycle_number),cycle_id=VALUES(cycle_id), last_trade_time=VALUES(last_trade_time),last_trade_id=VALUES(last_trade_id),updated_at=NOW(6)
mapper.update: UPDATE quant_strategy_position_rebuild_run SET status='VERIFIED',active_run_key=NULL,exchange_long_quantity=#{exchangeLong}, exchange_short_quantity=#{exchangeShort},rebuilt_long_quantity=#{rebuiltLong}, rebuilt_short_quantity=#{rebuiltShort},updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{runId} AND status='READY'
